metric: TRAIN-standardized, registered hierarchy-weighted mean squared error
input_view: length; character span and lexical token count at input coordinates68/69, with their registered masks; not length-only target scoring

measurement_transition.new_F1_F2_inputs: reconstructed TRAIN/DEV features using the unchanged pinned instrument and extraction protocol
measurement_transition.limitation: Original private feature caches and transform hashes were unavailable; exact historical transform byte identity is not established.

limitations: The model comparison has one prespecified initialization seed; the existing three-seed length F4 results do not supply missing F1/F2 replications.
DEV selects epochs; these are not unbiased held-out test estimates.
Input dimensions and parameter counts differ; score differences cannot uniquely isolate information content, model capacity or optimization effects.
Length is also represented by two scored targets. This total score does not isolate the65 linguistic targets or attribute the improvement to them.
No significance, component-level confidence interval or general model ranking is claimed.
Reconstructed versus historical measurement artifacts add a cross-phase comparison limitation.
The instrument remains unvalidated for full style, authorship, personal voice or rewriting.
